Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

West Midlands Police recorded 254 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 5.5 per 1,000 residents, the 16th highest rate of Coventry's 18 wards. The daytime score here is driven by vehicle crime (10), shoplifting (3), drugs (2); the evening/night score by violent crime (42), public order (4), anti social behaviour (2). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Whoberley safe?

Wandroz currently rates Whoberley in Coventry as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Coventry, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from West Midlands Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Whoberley safe at night?

At night, Whoberley is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Coventry. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Whoberley a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Whoberley's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Coventry) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
